mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_module_item (module_name, name, code, status, description, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{moduleName}, #{name}, #{code}, #{status}, #{description}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_module_item SET name = #{name}, code = #{code}, status = #{status}, description = #{description}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND module_name = #{moduleName}
